Hi Rebecca —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so we stay aligned with procurement and finance: 

Call recap:
- Use case: internal developer platform to reduce inference costs for customer-facing features (text generation + reranking).
- Expected starting footprint: ~2M tokens/month with burst to 10M for Q3 pilot.
- Key success metrics: latency 200–300ms p95, cost per 1k tokens target ~ 40% below current vendor.

Procurement / commercial path (what you outlined):
- Primary preference: purchase via AWS Marketplace (preferred by vendor management) to simplify invoicing and procurement.
- Fallback: direct PO to Redwood if Marketplace packaging rules block the deal (you indicated that's possible).
- Payment method: typically PO + net30; card only for small pilots (below $5k/mo).

Budget / approvals we discussed:
- Economic buyer: Lena Ortiz (VP Product) — ultimately signs off on budget for pilot.
- Finance sponsor: Daniel Park (Director of Finance) — handles PO and vendor onboarding.
- Signatory: Procurement legal team typically requires an approved SOW/order form; final signatory is Procurement Director.

Next steps (I can own these):
1) I'll attach an initial quote and our standard T&Cs / SLA for procurement to review (attached).
2) Could you introduce me to Daniel Park and the procurement contact (procurement@acme-corp.com) so we can kick off vendor onboarding?
3) Please confirm whether Marketplace is preferred or if Procurement will request a direct PO. If Marketplace, please confirm the vendor account name used for procurement.
4) Procurement asks we provide W-9 and COI — I can send those immediately once I have the procurement contact.

Attachments: redwood-sla-and-terms.pdf, quote-ACME-2026-045.xlsx

If that looks right, I’ll also propose a short follow-up meeting next week with Finance + Procurement to align timelines (targeting contract in place by end of Q2).
